title: AARO under Kirkpatrick as a fly trap for UFO information

tellings.quote: And it is now kind of patently obvious that the first iteration of this under Sean Kirkpatre was literally a fly trap for you know UFO information probably had legacy ties.

plain: Michels argues that AARO, the Pentagon office set up in 2022 to look into UAP (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's newer term for UFOs), was in its first form under its director Sean Kirkpatrick "literally a fly trap for UFO information", gathering what people knew rather than bringing it out, and that it "probably had legacy ties" to older secret programmes. He says this himself as his own reading, calling it "patently obvious", in a conversation with a guest named Dylan Borland. If he is right, the office meant to look into UFOs was really working to keep them secret.
